newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends little changed in tight range.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends little changed in tight range.

text.p: The won closed barely changed against the dollar on Wednesday after drifting directionlessly in a narrow range, dealers said.
The won finished at 826.80 after opening at 827.00. It was trapped in a range of 826.50 to 827.20.
The won opened strong in the morning on weaker dollar versus the Japanese yen in the world market, but dollar short-covering quickly erased the local unit's gain, dealers said.
"Dollar short-covering saved the dollar from falling below the low of 826.50," said a local dealer.
Upon finding resistance at 826.50, the won failed to break away from a range of 826.70-827.20.
"Banks are unsure of whether to buy or sell due to lack of direction in the market," one dealer said.
Traders said the won was likely to trade in a similar pattern on Thursday in a range of 826.50 to 827.50 with a base mid-rate of 826.90. Today's mid-rate was pegged at 827.90.
